Name: Bentleys Fast Food Useful Stuff
Author: BentleyThemodder
Description:
BENTLEY PLAYZ FAST FOOD & USEFUL STUFF
A Content Patcher mod made for Nick. No DLL, nothing to compile.

WHAT IT ADDS
- Bentley's Fast Food: a walk-in restaurant standing in Cindersap Forest, with its own interior and an ordering counter.
- Bentley: a new NPC who owns the restaurant. He is blonde, fair-skinned and marriageable, and he loves every gift. He has portraits and sprites, plus a winter outfit and a hazmat suit with a respirator for green rain.
- Five items: Cheeseburger, French Fries, Coke, Windex (a joke item) and the Farmhand Snack Pack. They have recipes and are sold at Gus's Saloon and at Bentley's counter.
- Town Pass: 200g at Pierre's or Bentley's counter, one per player. While you own it, the restaurant door is open day and night, even when Bentley is out.

HOW IT WORKS
- Bentley works behind the counter from the early morning. After closing he walks to Gus's Stardrop Saloon and hangs out there until about 23:30, then goes back home to the restaurant.
- The restaurant is open 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. The front door and the counter shop both follow those hours, and a poster next to the door shows them.
- Counter prices: Cheeseburger 180g, French Fries 90g, Coke 100g, Windex 25g, Farmhand Snack Pack 220g.
- The restaurant also appears on the Ice Festival versions of the Forest. The area around it is cleared of bushes, weeds and twigs on new saves.
- Optional config: ShopRequiresBentley (default false) makes the counter open only while Bentley is inside.

REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (other 1.6.x versions untested)
- SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer
- Content Patcher 2.6.0 or newer
No other framework is needed.

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Extract the ZIP so that Mods/BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff/manifest.json exists.
3. Delete any older copy first. All versions use the same mod ID.
4. Launch the game with SMAPI.

UPDATING FROM OLDER VERSIONS
If you built the restaurant on your Farm with a version before 3.0.0, demolish it first. From 3.0.0 on, the restaurant stands in the Forest and there is no building step.

LATEST CHANGES (3.5.3)
- Fixed: the back of the restaurant is now solid. Before, you could walk behind the building with your head going through the roof.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS
- NONE

Check out this video "Stardew Showcasing A Custom Mod" https://www.twitch.tv/bentleyforgothispassword/v/2915954957?sr=a

NOTE
Windex is a fictional joke item. Real glass cleaner is poisonous. Never drink it.

CREDITS
Made by Bentley Playz.
